runners.comment: Came up short in the Challow but enters calculations back down in class; course winner
runners.name: Etna Bianco
runners.owner: L Hunt M-A Middleton J P Romans
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism at Ascot (2m5f, good) in November, building on reappearance effort; came up short in the Challow since but enters calculations back down in class, even with 8lb penalty; tongue-tie fitted.

runners.comment: Justified favouritism at Ludlow last time; may build on that win and progress further
runners.name: Catchintsavo
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism in maiden hurdle at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) last time, gaining reward for being largely consistent in defeat previously; may build on that success and show further progress.

runners.comment: Justified favouritism in clearcut style at Ludlow on stable/hurdles debut; respected
runners.name: Mondouiboy
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo; bought from the David Maxwell dispersal for £115,000; justified favouritism in clearcut style at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) on stable/hurdles debut and should improve further; respected.

runners.comment: Got tired on heavy ground last time; progressive otherwise; leading chance on ratings
runners.name: Starzand
runners.spotlight: Got rather tired on the heavy ground when beaten favourite at Leicester (2m4f) last time; progressive otherwise and ran well earlier in January when bidding for a Ffos Las hat-trick; leading chance on ratings.

runners.comment: Made the frame several times in Ireland; couple of lesser efforts for new stable
runners.name: Coumeenoole
runners.spotlight: Made the frame several times in Ireland but has posted a couple of lesser efforts for new stable, taking rules record to 0-10; faces a stiff assignment in this field.

runners.comment: Went close in sole Irish start; half-brother to a five-time winner for his new yard
runners.name: Kildinan Prince
runners.spotlight: Showed promise with head second, clear of remainder, in Tipperary maiden hurdle (3m1f) in sole start for Jonathan Sweeney; half-brother to a five-time winner for his new yard; interesting.

13:50.race_name: Injured Jockeys Fund Ambassadors Programme Reynoldstown Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Has done well this term, winning at Ascot then second in Kempton Grade 1; top rated
runners.name: Thomas Mor
runners.spotlight: Underperformed in one chase attempt last term but has done well (on good ground) this season, winning at Ascot (2m5f) then good second in Grade 1 novice at Kempton (3m); has form on soft; top on ratings.

runners.breeder: R D & Mrs J S Chugg
runners.comment: Best to forgive latest effort (bled from nose); has progressive RPRs otherwise
runners.name: Crest Of Fortune
runners.spotlight: Perhaps best to forgive his heavy defeat, behind Thomas Mor, at Kempton last time (bled from nose); has largely progressive RPRs otherwise and has Graded form; first chase win is not implausible.

runners.comment: Successful in C&D handicap last time, taking chase record to 2-3; commands respect
runners.name: The Jukebox Kid
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism in C&D handicap (soft) on Clarence House day, taking chase record to 2-3 and overall strike-rate to 4-6; yard landed this prize in 2024; respected with further progress on the cards.

runners.comment: Open to further progress and his stable has a good record in this race; interesting
runners.name: Western Knight
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-3 since switched to fences, most recently scoring at Doncaster (2m3f, soft); has form at up to 3m; open to further improvement and his stable has a good record in this contest; interesting.

runners.breeder: R D & Mrs J S Chugg
runners.comment: Useful mare but last two efforts suggest she's unlikely to defy top weight in this field
runners.name: Kateira
runners.spotlight: Useful mare (dual Listed scorer) but last two efforts, latest back at handicap level, suggest she's unlikely to defy top weight in this warm field.

runners.comment: Landed a notable autumn prize but has failed to show his form in two starts since
runners.name: Rambo T
runners.spotlight: Landed a notable autumn prize at Chepstow (2m3f, good) but has failed to show his form in two starts since; current mark demands a career best.

runners.comment: Interesting off current mark assuming he retains ability; won the Challow in 2023
runners.name: Captain Teague
runners.spotlight: Seemed to need latest run when back from a lengthy layoff; interesting off current mark assuming he's still capable of peak form, which includes a success in the 2023 Challow on soft ground.

runners.comment: On a 15-month losing spell but is a consistent sort; again has frame possibilities
runners.name: Act Of Authority
runners.spotlight: Acts on soft ground; on a 15-month losing spell but is a consistent sort, creditable fourth to Listentoyourheart at Windsor (2m4f) most recently; again has frame possibilities.

runners.comment: Has useful winning form at Ascot (1m7f) and this new trip is worth exploring
runners.name: Fiercely Proud
runners.spotlight: Folded tamely last time when bidding to land a notable Ascot handicap (1m7f) for the second year running; capable of being involved on best form and has sometimes shaped as if this new trip is worth exploring.

runners.breeder: Patrice Vagne & Dr V Pierre Colson
runners.comment: Disappointing in both starts this term; previously a progressive sort with a solid record
runners.name: Jurancon
runners.spotlight: Acts on heavy ground; disappointing in both starts this term but can't be written off just yet; previously a progressive sort with a good strike-rate and solid record.

runners.comment: Steadily back to form this term; landed a valuable event at Windsor most recently
runners.name: Listentoyourheart
runners.owner: S T Racing - The Founders Syndicate
runners.spotlight: Has bits of form on soft, campaigned mostly on faster ground; steadily back to form this term and landed a valuable handicap, holding on by a neck, at Windsor (2m4f) most recently; should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Needs good ground; returns to hurdles for first time since 2023; new headgear
runners.name: Hurricane Bay
runners.spotlight: Capable of fairly useful form over hurdles/fences but is best on good ground; returns to this sphere for first time since 2023; new headgear.

runners.comment: Has form figures of 121 since upped to 2m4f; may improve further at this sort of trip
runners.name: John Barbour
runners.spotlight: Second-season hurdler who has form figures of 121 since upped to 2m4f, both wins at Uttoxeter (good to soft); goes into deeper waters but may improve further at this sort of distance; respected.

runners.comment: Had little to spare at Sandown last time but the runner-up has franked the form since
runners.name: Range
runners.spotlight: Acts on any ground; had very little to spare at Sandown (2m4f) most recently but the runner-up has franked the form since; still competitively treated back up 2lb, assuming he takes to first-time headgear.

runners.comment: Useful at best but has weak claims on his form for current yard; cheekpieces added
runners.name: No Ordinary Joe
runners.spotlight: Useful for previous stable but holds weak claims on his form for current yard; added cheekpieces need to have a reviving effect.

runners.comment: Physical tweak (wind surgery since last run) needs to make a difference
runners.name: De Temps En Temps
runners.spotlight: Novice hurdler who has failed to sustain his progress in two handicap attempts; physical tweak (wind surgery since last run) needs to make a difference.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 7yo whose form has substance; solid third at Hereford in sole run this term
runners.name: Lightningupourdays
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo whose form has substance; solid third, behind subsequent scorers, at Hereford (2m3f, soft) in sole run this term; particularly unexposed at this trip and looks interesting off a low weight.

runners.comment: Won over hurdles in November and good second over fences last time; this is harder
runners.name: Kamaxos
runners.spotlight: Form for new yard features a win over hurdles in November and good second over fences last time, both in Class 4; this is a harder task.

runners.comment: On a 13-race losing sequence but has consistent Ascot form and should give his running
runners.name: Moveit Like Minnie
runners.owner: F J Mills & W R Mills
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent record at Ascot includes a sixth-place finish in this contest last year and placed effort in latest start; on a 13-race losing sequence but should give his running.

15:00.race_name: Betfair Swinley Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Gained last three wins in veterans' events; opposed in this field
runners.name: Sam Brown
runners.spotlight: Useful for a long time but has gained last three wins in veterans' events and, having turned 14 since November reappearance, can be opposed off current mark in this field.

runners.comment: Has a good record in this race but there's a doubt over his current form
runners.name: Threeunderthrufive
runners.spotlight: Two attempts in this race comprise a success in 2024 and close second last year, both off higher marks; however, has a doubt over current form and needs to stage a revival.

runners.comment: Record of 2-3 over 2m5f at Ascot; ran well over a sharp 3m at Kempton last time
runners.name: Your Darling
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-3 over 2m5f at Ascot, all in the same November race; showed he stays 3m, at least under sharp conditions, at Kempton (good) most recently; this is a stiffer test at the trip.

runners.comment: Won a notable veterans' prize at Sandown last time, taking record over 3m to 2-3
runners.name: Nocte Volatus
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism in the 2025 Stayers' Veterans' Chase Final at Sandown (good) most recently, taking record over 3m to 2-3; in top form aged 11 and still unexposed at this distance.

runners.comment: Readily opened his chase account in Leicester event last time; may improve further
runners.name: Jipcot
runners.spotlight: Readily opened his chase account in Leicester event (2m6f, good to soft) last time; may build on that success and show further progress over fences; has form at 3m; enters calculations.

runners.comment: Still going nicely in clear lead when falling in major handicap at Doncaster last time
runners.name: Joyeux Machin
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-9 for current yard but he ran well over hurdles on this card last year; still going nicely in clear lead when falling six out in major handicap chase at Doncaster (3m, soft) most recently; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Gained last two wins in veterans' races; others preferred
runners.name: Credo
runners.spotlight: Successful in two legs of the 2025 Stayers' Veterans' Chase Series but came up short in the Final won by Nocte Volatus; hasn't won a conventional race since 2023.

runners.comment: Consistent over 3m of late but is perhaps ideally suited by shorter
runners.name: Hunter Legend
runners.spotlight: Has posted consistent efforts over 3m of late but gives the impression he ideally needs a drop back in trip, especially when conditions are testing; yet to win beyond an extended 2m6f.

runners.comment: Record of 11P2 since wearing visor features two sound performances over C&D; respected
runners.name: Montregard
runners.spotlight: Record of 11P2 since wearing visor features two sound performances over C&D (good/soft), latest behind today's Reynoldstown contender The Jukebox Kid; 3lb out of weights but still respected in the retained headgear.

runners.comment: Remains in form but faces a stiffer task from out of the weights upped in class
runners.name: Invincible Nao
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort who scored over 2m4f on reappearance and has performed respectably over marathon trips since; faces a stiffer task from 4lb out of the handicap upped in class.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten in last two appearances; needs to prove he retains peak ability
runners.name: Gericault Roque
runners.owner: Prof Caroline Tisdall And Bryan Drew
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced since 2022; soundly beaten in last two appearances, taking chase record to 0-9, and needs to prove he retains peak ability; 4lb out of weights; cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Useful for Tom Lacey but faces a stiff task at this level on debut for new yard
runners.name: Blow Your Wad
runners.spotlight: Useful for Tom Lacey; very lightly raced in the last two years but seems to retain plenty of ability judged on his Ascot handicap efforts (3m) this term, better than bare result latest; however, faces a much stiffer task at this level on debut for new yard; still with same owners.

runners.comment: All wins at about 2m; has the worst chance at the weights; easily opposed
runners.name: Classic Maestro
runners.spotlight: Has rules form at up to 2m6f but has done all his winning at about 2m and latest effort, namely second in Sandown handicap, doesn't suggest he's crying out for this step back up in distance; moreover, has the worst chance at the weights upped in class.

runners.comment: 12 years old but bagged Grade 2 honours last time; Grade 1 winner in his prime
runners.name: Edwardstone
runners.spotlight: Acts on any ground; formerly a high-class chaser at about 2m, best form when winning the 2022 Tingle Creek; seems better suited by further nowadays and, despite his advancing years, managed to land a Grade 2 prize over 2m4f at Kempton most recently; recapturing Grade 1 honours at the age of 12 is not completely implausible, as he's technically still unexposed at this sort of trip and his two main rivals are also veterans.

runners.comment: Handicapper who is out of his depth in this grade; faller on last two starts
runners.name: Heltenham
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late N W Lake
runners.spotlight: Useful on his day but has done most of his racing in handicaps and this first crack at Grade 1 level presents a much tougher assignment; no certainty to get round either, having been a faller on last two starts, taking record this season to 0-7; latest tumble was over C&D.

runners.comment: Strong finish over 2m1f at Ascot last time, recording an 11th Grade 1 win; 2-2 over 2m4f
runners.name: Jonbon
runners.spotlight: Acts on any ground; yet to finish out of the first two; formerly dominant at shorter but has lost a bit of his speed and was aided by the stiff test over the 2m1f trip at Ascot (soft) most recently, recording a second success in the Clarence House and 11th Grade 1 win; seems to be crying out for this step back up in distance and, still high class at the age of ten, may well add to his impressive tally; 2-2 over 2m4f, both in the Melling at Aintree; cheekpieces worn in last two starts are retained.

runners.comment: Record of 5-9 over fences at Ascot features emphatic wins in this race for last two years
runners.name: Pic Dorhy
runners.spotlight: Smart front-runner whose record of 5-9 over fences at Ascot features emphatic wins in this race for the last two years (good/good to soft; has scored on soft); had excuses (soon taken on for lead, race possibly came too soon after reappearance) over C&D in November when last seen, failing to land the 1965 Chase for a third time; perhaps best caught fresh nowadays and, assuming he's able to dominate, commands respect in another hat-trick attempt.

16:10.race_name: Betfair Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Stayers Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Absent since encouraging seasonal debut in November but completely unexposed as a stayer
runners.name: Kalium
runners.spotlight: 3-5 as a novice hurdler last season; absent since encouraging third of seven on reappearance outing at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) in November but could quite plausibly have untapped potential over this new trip.

runners.comment: Second on seasonal/chase debut in December; quickly back hurdling after lacklustre run
runners.name: Operation Manna
runners.spotlight: Returned from one-year absence with good second on chase debut at Exeter (3m, heavy) in December but looked out of sorts when pulled up last month and it's hard to know what to expect from him on return to hurdling.

runners.comment: Thorough stayer; didn't fire in Welsh National; hurdling ability tricky to gauge
runners.name: Hung Jury
runners.spotlight: Thorough stayer who won amateur riders' chase at Cheltenham (3m1f, heavy) in November and was second in London National at Sandown (3m4f, good to soft) on next outing; didn't fire in Welsh National last time, though, and his hurdling ability is tricky to gauge.

runners.breeder: S C E A De Maulde Et Al
runners.comment: Fourth in this race in 2024; absent since pair of 2m7f chase wins the following month
runners.name: Loup De Maulde
runners.spotlight: Ran well when fourth in this race in 2024 (good to soft) and won two soft-ground chases (both 2m7f) the following month but will need to return from 690-day absence in prime form to have any chance off current mark.

runners.breeder: Sas Elevage Du Haras De Bourgeauville
runners.comment: Good winner at Warwick (2m5f) in December but stamina might be stretched here
runners.name: Yellow Star
runners.owner: Tim Lord Kc And G L Moore
runners.spotlight: Showed career-best form when winning readily by 4l at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft; refitted cheekpieces) in December; subsequent lesser effort in major Kempton handicap is not viewed harshly but 2m7f on soft ground will take his stamina into unknown territory.

runners.comment: Improving 7yo who bids for a hat-trick after emphatic wins at Uttoxeter and Market Rasen
runners.name: Heart Over Head
runners.spotlight: Improving 7yo who bids for a hat-trick after emphatic wins at Uttoxeter (2m6f, heavy) and Market Rasen (2m7f, good to soft); moves up in grade here but still needs to be taken very seriously.

runners.comment: Chasing has not gone to plan this season but he reverts to hurdling on a workable mark
runners.name: Il Va De Soi
runners.spotlight: Well held when third on seasonal/chase debut in November and now reverts to hurdling after two non-completions; has more to prove than some of these but current mark is workable and he's unexposed as a stayer.

runners.comment: Gave good account when back over hurdles in first-time visor at Newbury last month
runners.name: High Treason
runners.spotlight: Began season with two below-par chase runs in the autumn but gave good account when fifth of 17 over hurdles at Newbury (3m, good to soft; first-time visor) last month and will be fine on the slower ground here.

runners.comment: Much better known as a chaser now; slow ground a big worry on return to hurdling
runners.name: Sea Invasion
runners.spotlight: Much better known as a chaser now; left disappointing seasonal debut behind when very respectable third of five at Wincanton (3m, good) last month but the slower ground is a big worry on this return to hurdling.

runners.comment: Looked laboured on recent outings; needs new cheekpieces to perk him up
runners.name: Oh My Johnny
runners.owner: Richard Johnson Racing- Oh My Johnny
runners.spotlight: Scored off today's mark at Hereford (2m3f, good to soft) a year ago, his second handicap, but made his jockey work very hard before eventually plugging on for modest second at Uttoxeter (2m7f, soft) in December and was pulled up on latest outing; needs first-time cheekpieces to perk him up.

runners.comment: Made good progress last season and positives can be drawn from his reappearance run
runners.name: Solar System
runners.spotlight: Three wins from off the pace last season (2m3f-2m5f, good to soft/soft); managed only fifth on last month's return at Haydock (3m, good to soft) but was quite badly hampered by a mid-race faller and made good headway from the rear on the final circuit; might come on for the run; interesting.

runners.comment: In the frame at Exeter on all three starts this season; needs to find extra here
runners.name: Diamatiste
runners.spotlight: Won at Exeter (2m5f, heavy) just under a year ago and has made the frame over 2m7f there on all three starts this season but has a bit more on his plate in this higher grade and needs a career-best effort.

runners.breeder: E A R L La Teerre Aux Duex Lunes Et Al
runners.comment: Made all at Huntingdon (2m4f) in December; held since; not bred for this new trip
runners.name: Walden
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins last year, the latter from the front in Huntingdon handicap (2m4f, soft) in December; not in same form when well-held third off same mark at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) ten days later, though, and now 5lb higher; upped in trip again.

runners.comment: Kept on for fourth of 17 at Newbury (3m) last month and remains unexposed as a stayer
runners.name: Crazierthandaisy
runners.spotlight: Won on seasonal debut at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) in November and put a poor run behind her when fourth of 17 at Newbury (3m, good to soft) month, where a last-flight jumping error cost her momentum; suited by soft ground (unraced on heavy) and still unexposed at around 3m.

runners.comment: Won well on seasonal debut (after wind op) but well held since; younger rivals preferred
runners.name: Stratton Oakmont
runners.spotlight: Showed the benefit of a wind op and looked as good as ever when scoring by over 9l on seasonal debut at Exeter (2m7f, good) in November; also suited by soft/heavy ground but disappointed when last in action and will probably find younger rivals better handicapped here.

runners.breeder: Mrs Marie Merienne & Mr Julien Merienne
runners.comment: Shaped well before fading into sixth at Lingfield (2m3f) last month; still has low mileage
runners.name: Confinentic
runners.spotlight: 2-5 over hurdles; dropped out very tamely on seasonal debut in December (2m5f) but shaped well before fading into sixth at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) last month; tries a new trip here; might still have potential.

runners.comment: On the downgrade now and ended 2025 with two disappointing efforts
runners.name: Striking A Pose
runners.owner: S Clare G Kennington & C Knowles
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner; will be suited by today's trip/ground but is on the downgrade now and ended last year with two disappointing efforts (chase/hurdle).

runners.comment: Came good at Aintree in December and ran well in defeat in big field last month; a player
runners.name: Top Guy
runners.spotlight: Came good over hurdles when upped to 3m at Aintree (soft) in December, his seventh attempt, and bettered that performance when second of 17 at Newbury (3m, good to soft) last month; could still have more to offer; big player.

16:45.race_name: Betfair Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Point winner; followed up on rules debut and second in Listed race since; leading claims
runners.name: The Flaggy Shore
runners.spotlight: Won easily on Irish point debut last spring and impressed again on rules debut at Warwick (good to soft) in November, drawing clear to score comfortably by 7l; bettered that form when second in a Listed race at Market Rasen (good to soft) four weeks ago; looks good enough to defy a penalty.

runners.comment: Much respected newcomer from top yard with a 20% bumper strike-rate in last five seasons
runners.name: Burning Embers
runners.owner: S T Racing Burnt Ends Partnership
runners.spotlight: 35,000 euros daughter of Getaway whose dam won a bumper before going on to show fairly useful winning form over hurdles; debuts for a top yard with a 20% strike-rate in bumpers in the last five seasons; respected, particularly if the betting vibes are strong.

runners.comment: Promise in good-ground bumper but will need to improve to win this
runners.name: Grizzled Squirrel
runners.owner: Galloping On The South Downs Partnership
runners.spotlight: Some promise in two good-ground bumpers last summer, finishing third at Uttoxeter latterly; will need to step up on that form to seriously trouble One Dimensional, though.

runners.comment: Half-sister to a bumper winner; dam also bumper winner so bred for the job; check betting
runners.name: Harzandacassandra
runners.owner: DL Adams JA Adams & G McPherson
runners.spotlight: £25,000 half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Speculatrix; dam also a bumper winner so she is bred for the job; stable gets the odd bumper winner; check the betting.

runners.comment: Promising fifth of 14 in Huntingdon Listed bumper on debut; the pick on form
runners.name: One Dimensional
runners.spotlight: 50-1 and hooded, produced an encouraging debut effort when fifth of 14 in Huntingdon Listed bumper (soft) in December, finishing strongly from the rear; the pick on form.

runners.comment: 33-1, faded into sixth on Newcastle debut 315 days ago
runners.name: Queen Marcia
runners.spotlight: Absent since fading into sixth on Newcastle debut (2m1f, good) 315 days ago; needs to leave that well behind.

runners.comment: One of two newcomers from yard which has had a first-time-out bumper winner this season
runners.name: Galante De Vassy
runners.owner: Karen Ibberson Henry Pearman T Symonds
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to French 9.5f AW winner Gloire De Vassy out of an unraced half-sister to some useful Flat winners there; her yard, which has had a first-time-out bumper winner this season, also runs Miss Roc On Sal and the betting should help to separate them.

runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to yard's 2m/2m4f Group 1 Flat winner Trueshan; betting informative
runners.name: Martini Majesty
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to yard's 2m/2m4f Group 1 Flat winner Trueshan; Alan King has had a first-time-out bumper winner this season and this daughter of Planteur would enter calculations if the market speaks in her favour.

runners.comment: Out of unraced half-sister to Shishkin; one of two from yard; the betting should guide
runners.name: Miss Roc On Sal
runners.owner: C Bennett W Bennett And J Buckley
runners.spotlight: By Shirocco and the first foal of an unraced sister to bumper and top-class 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Shishkin; might be the stable's first string given that Ben Poste partners quite a lot of the yard's runners, including its first-time-out bumper winner earlier in the season.

runners.comment: Market confidence would look significant for a yard well known for bumper success
runners.name: Ms Des Fois
runners.spotlight: Closely related to yard's smart bumper and 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase winner Ms Parfois and half-sister to two other hurdle winners; stable is well known for its prowess in bumpers so market confidence would look significant.

12:55.race_name: Richard Howard 80th Birthday Celebration Victor Ludorum Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Easily scored at Sandown then only fourth in Finale at Chepstow; remains of interest
runners.name: Macktoad
runners.spotlight: Bought for 125,000euros after bagging a Vichy bumper last spring and looked a good prospect for new connections when easily making a winning start in this sphere in Sandown juvenile (2m, soft) in December; proved a big let-down when only fourth of five in Finale at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) but remains of interest with cheekpieces now fitted for a yard with an excellent record in this event.

runners.comment: Useful ex-French winning hurdler; interesting prospect for top yard on back of wind op
runners.name: The Mighty Celt
runners.spotlight: A useful 1m7f winning hurdler at Auteuil last spring and also runner-up in a 2m2f Listed hurdle there in the autumn for Noel George and Amanda Zetterholm; has since changed hands for 145,000euros and he rates an interesting prospect for top yard on the back of breathing surgery/gelding op; hood also added.

runners.comment: Advanced form with emphatic Wincanton success latest; more to offer so enters calculations
runners.name: Pourquoi Pas Papa
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful efforts when runner-up on his first three runs over hurdles (with David Cottin for Clairefontaine debut last summer) before advancing his form with an emphatic success in 1m7f Wincanton maiden 16 days ago, forging clear from the last; he looks to have even more to offer so must enter calculations.

runners.comment: Made it 2-3 over hurdles at Newbury; this demands more but she shouldn't be underestimated
runners.name: Love Sonnet
runners.spotlight: Progressive 1m6f Flat winner in Ireland last summer for John Joseph Murphy; is going very much the right way in this sphere too for her new yard, comfortably making it 2-3 over hurdles in 2m juvenile at Newbury in December; this demands plenty more but she shouldn't be underestimated after a break.

runners.comment: Shaped well after ten months off when second in Doncaster Listed event; very good claims
runners.name: Manlaga
runners.spotlight: Debut 1m7f hurdles scorer at Auteuil for Marcel Rolland last March and she shaped very well after ten months off when a clear second of five in Doncaster Listed (2m, soft) event three weeks ago; seems sure to build on that now and this Triumph Hurdle entrant holds very good claims.

runners.comment: Encouraging debut sixth at Leopardstown in December; faces a tall order here though
runners.name: Try Them
runners.spotlight: 25-1 and hooded, encouraging debut sixth of 15 in juvenile hurdle at Leopardstown (2m2f, good to yielding) in December; in very good hands but faces a tall order here.

runners.comment: Clear second in Catterick juvenile latest; open to progress but this demands a lot more
runners.name: Whatsgoingonmarvin
runners.spotlight: A fairly useful and three-time Flat scorer (at up to 1m6f) for Sir Mark Prescott in 2025; beat only one on his hurdling debut at Kempton but vastly improved when a clear second of nine in 2m Catterick juvenile 15 days ago; open to further progress but this demands plenty more.

runners.comment: Fair Irish Flat maiden but this is a very tough introduction to hurdling
runners.name: Word For Word
runners.spotlight: Harzand gelding who showed fair form in a trio of Irish middle-distance maidens last summer for John Joseph Murphy; brings potential to hurdling but this is a very tough introduction.

13:28.race_name: QED Scaffolding Ltd Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Not at his best this term, only fifth of six at Windsor latest; veteran looks vulnerable
runners.name: Nells Son
runners.spotlight: A smart winning chaser at his peak but not at his best this term, only fifth of six in 2m Windsor handicap chase 27 days ago; his mark is falling but this veteran still looks vulnerable conceding weight all round here.

runners.comment: Pulled up in 3m Bangor handicap in November; much more is needed after a break here
runners.name: Pull Again Green
runners.spotlight: A dual chase scorer (at up to 2m7f) last summer but his more recent form is not nearly so encouraging, pulled up in 3m Bangor handicap in November; much more is needed after a break here.

runners.comment: Pulled up in Topham at Aintree last April on final run for Charlie Longsdon; stable debut
runners.name: Western Zephyr
runners.spotlight: Made a winning return at Carlisle (2m) in October 2024 but his form nosedived later in the season, pulled up in the Topham at Aintree last spring on his final run for Charlie Longsdon; since changed hands for £20,000 and he needs to hit the ground running for his new yard after ten months off.

runners.comment: Scored at Listowel in September; 11lb higher but Irish raider can't be totally dismissed
runners.name: Bythesametoken
runners.spotlight: Made light of a 13-month absence when landing 2m1f handicap chase at Listowel in September; 11lb higher today but that form worked out well so this Irish challenger can't be totally dismissed after another layoff.

runners.comment: Scored twice in spring of 2024; off 23 months but no forlorn hope with yard going well
runners.name: Twoshotsoftequila
runners.spotlight: On the up when last seen out in the spring of 2024, bagging a pair of handicap chases (around 3m) at Catterick and Newcastle; has a 23-month absence to overcome here but yard is among the winners so he's no forlorn hope.

runners.breeder: Dr V Bernard Stoffel & Mr Vincent Leroy
runners.comment: Improved for new yard, excellent Leicester second latest; merits serious consideration
runners.name: The Bluesman
runners.spotlight: A fairly useful bumper/hurdles winner for Paul Nicholls; has looked an improved model sent chasing for his new handler this winter, scoring easily at Southwell (2m4f) before a clear second of six in 2m4f Leicester handicap 48 days ago; up 4lb but he has more to offer and merits serious consideration.

runners.comment: Pulled up at Doncaster three weeks ago; plenty more is required despite a tumbling mark
runners.name: Harsh
runners.owner: M Gowing P Booker & D Jewers
runners.spotlight: Capable of useful form over fences in Ireland for Gordon Elliott but he's still to score in this sphere and has offered little for his new yard, jumping sketchily when pulled up in 3m Doncaster handicap three weeks ago; plenty more is required despite a tumbling mark.

runners.comment: Readily completed a hat-trick over C&D latest; form has been franked so rates a big player
runners.name: Throatlash
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who hasn't looked back since having wind surgery, readily completing a hat-trick over C&D four weeks ago; up another 5lb but that form has been franked so this sound-jumping front-runner rates a big player.

runners.comment: Yet to convince in a trio of runs over fences, beaten in a match at Warwick latest
runners.name: Anyharminasking
runners.spotlight: A useful 2m-winning hurdler but he's not the most reliable and has yet to convince in a trio of runs over fences, beaten in a match at Warwick (2m4f) when last seen out in October; others are preferred.

runners.comment: Has failed to go on over fences, falling at the ninth fence at Doncaster nine days ago
runners.name: Gentleman Bill
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful bumper/hurdles scorer who shaped well on his chasing debut when third in 2m Aintree handicap in October; has failed to build on it though in three subsequent outings, falling at the ninth fence at Doncaster (2m4f) nine days ago; has something to prove now.

runners.comment: Scored at Newcastle in November but very in and out since; not easy to warm to today
runners.name: Taras Halls
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways in first-time blinkers at Newcastle (2m4f) in November but very in and out since, pulled up in 2m6f Leicester handicap chase 25 days ago; he's not easy to warm to today.

runners.comment: Yet to score this term but he arrives in decent nick; possibilities off a 2lb lower mark
runners.name: Cerendipity
runners.spotlight: Yet to score this term but he arrives in decent nick, scuppered by a bad error when sixth over C&D last month; possibilities off a 2lb lower mark.

runners.comment: Powered clear up the Cheltenham hill for 2m4f Grade 2 win; leading claims if seeing it out
runners.name: Kabral Du Mathan
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who won handicap here (2m3f, good to soft) in November on stable debut and followed up in Grade 2 Relkeel Hurdle at Cheltenham (extended 2m4f, good), again with plenty in hand; also effective on soft ground; now needs to prove his stamina for this new trip but he powered clear up the hill last time and will be tough to beat if seeing it out.

runners.comment: Impressive in h'cap at favourite course Sandown last time; not ruled out on first run here
runners.name: Henri The Second
runners.spotlight: Easily won a handicap at Sandown (2m7f, heavy) a fortnight ago; his three hurdle wins have come there and he needs to prove he can reproduce his best form at a different track, but today's trip and forecast soft ground will be right up his street and he's not ruled out on his first run here.

runners.comment: Pulled up last time but wind surgery since; second in this last year; could make bold bid
runners.name: Beauport
runners.spotlight: 10yo who was pulled up in Grade 1 Long Walk Hurdle at Ascot in December and conditional Toby McCain-Mitchell is unable to claim today; however, he's had wind surgery since his latest outing, which might help, and he was second in this 12 months ago having finished third in the Long Walk the time before; it will be no surprise to see a bold bid from this prominent-racer.

runners.comment: Two 2m4f handicap wins then mid-division at Kempton; this 6yo may still have more to offer
runners.name: French Ship
runners.spotlight: Won big-field handicaps at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) and Newbury (2m4f, soft) in the autumn; having gone up the weights he was merely mid-division at Kempton (2m5f, good) last month and is untested at today's trip, but this lightly raced 6yo may still have more to offer and is not discounted.

runners.comment: Something to find if rivals are on song but that isn't guaranteed; in good form and stays
runners.name: Ludor
runners.spotlight: Won easily on handicap debut at Bangor (2m3f, soft) in November and has continued in good form, finishing third of 15 at Windsor (3m, soft) latest; he has something to find if his opponents are at their best but that isn't guaranteed, and his current wellbeing and proven stamina are both positives.

runners.comment: Listed mares' winner in December but held in fourth in mares' Grade 2 last month
runners.name: Lavida Adiva
runners.spotlight: 7yo who has shown improved form this season and won a Listed mares' hurdle at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) in December; similar form when held in fourth in mares' Grade 2 there (3m, soft) three weeks ago and it seems likely she'll prove vulnerable today; wears a first-time hood.

14:40.race_name: Albert Bartlett Prestige Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Went close in C&D handicap in December but pulled up in Grade 2 novice at Doncaster since
runners.name: Caughtinyourtrance
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Cartmel (2m6f, soft/good) last summer and went close in a handicap over this C&D (good to soft) in December; however, pulled up at 100-1 in a Grade 2 at Doncaster (3m, soft) last time; others preferred.

runners.comment: C&D win on h'cap debut & open to further improvement for top yard; firmly in calculations
runners.name: Dalston Lad
runners.owner: Cherry Knoll Farm M Ward & D Skelton
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 in these cheekpieces when upped in trip on handicap debut over C&D (good to soft) four weeks ago; won a bumper on soft ground; open to further improvement for his top yard and is firmly in calculations.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: Won at Kempton in November; two respectable efforts since but needs something extra
runners.name: Kasino Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Won at Kempton (2m5f, good) in November on second hurdle start before 5l fifth of seven in Grade 2 at Cheltenham (3m, good to soft) and solid third in warm Ascot novice (2m5f, soft); needs something extra today.

runners.comment: 2-2 over hurdles; up in grade today but could relish the step up in trip; one to consider
runners.name: Legendary Luke
runners.spotlight: 3m point winner who is 2-2 over hurdles following wins at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft) and Fontwell (2m3f, soft); up in grade today and others have more substance to their form but his dam is a half-sister to Gold Cup winner Native River and he could relish this step up in trip; he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Tougher test of credentials today but he looked good last time and could be involved
runners.name: Lon Chaney
runners.spotlight: 3m point runner-up who built upon the promise of his first two hurdle starts (2m4f, soft) with comfortable win in four-runner maiden at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve; this is a much tougher test of his credentials but he looked good last time and could be involved.

runners.comment: Going back left-handed may be a negative but he's entitled to respect after Kempton romp
runners.name: Reckless Spending
runners.owner: Mrs G Van Geest & M George
runners.spotlight: Left previous form behind to win easily for top yard in a novice hurdle at Kempton (2m5f, good to soft) 12 days ago, and there's every chance this 3m point runner-up will be fine now back up in trip; unraced on soft/heavy ground and he jumped to the right last time so reverting to a left-handed track may be a negative, but he's entitled to respect after last time.

runners.comment: Step up in trip may suit but there's a suspicion his limitations will again be exposed
runners.name: Skuna Bay
runners.spotlight: Made all in Bangor novice (2m7f, soft) in November on fourth hurdle start; no match for Ubatuba when second at Leicester (2m4f, heavy) last month; the step up in trip may be a positive for this fellow but there's a suspicion his limitations will be exposed once more.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: Smart Flat stayer in his prime; goes up in trip but others have more pressing claims
runners.name: Tashkhan
runners.spotlight: Smart stayer on the Flat in his prime and won on hurdle debut at Hexham (2m4f, heavy) in December; another good run when third at Kelso (2m6f, good to soft) next time then well beaten in Grade 2 here (1m7f, good to soft); this longer trip could suit but others have more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Two comfortable wins at Leicester and remains to be seen where ceiling of his ability lies
runners.name: Ubatuba
runners.spotlight: 3m point winner who has won with lots in hand at Leicester (2m4f, soft/heavy) on both hurdle starts; up in grade today and Ben Sutton can't claim his usual 5lb but his latest performance reads well and it remains to be seen where the ceiling of his ability lies; on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Won warm novice at Ascot on hurdle debut; could play another leading role up in trip/grade
runners.name: Whiskey Yankee
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in sole bumper and won warm novice at Ascot (2m5f, soft) last month when wearing a first-time tongue-tie (retained) on hurdle debut; his talented brother Ed Keeper (same connections) was at his best over 3m and this bright prospect could play another leading role now up in trip/grade.

15:15.race_name: William Hill Half A Mill Grand National Trial Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 10yo; career-best when winning here in November but well held in Tommy Whittle here since
runners.name: Top Of The Bill
runners.spotlight: 10yo who posted a career-best performance with comfortable win here (extended 3m1f, good to soft) in November, and he's also won on soft ground; not written off after just one below-par run but he was well held in the Tommy Whittle here in December and has to leave that effort miles behind.

runners.comment: 5th of 17 in Welsh National and now back down to last winning mark; might not be far away
runners.name: Monbeg Genius
runners.spotlight: 10yo who won at Uttoxeter (3m, soft) last February and returned to form when fifth of 17 in the Welsh National at Chepstow (3m6f, good to soft) in December, when 7l and two places behind Deafening Silence; now back down to last winning mark and might not be far away.

runners.comment: Needs to minimise the mistakes but there remains optimism he's superior to current mark
runners.name: Myretown
runners.spotlight: Bad blunders have been costly on both starts this season and he comes with risk attached; however, he was going nicely in front when ploughing through three out in the Peter Marsh here (3m1f, good to soft) four weeks ago, and there remains optimism he is superior to a mark 15lb higher than when bolting up in the Ultima at Cheltenham (3m1f, good to soft) last March; has also won on soft and there's every chance he'll stay this far.

runners.comment: Stayed on well for neck second in the Peter Marsh; well worth a crack at a marathon trip
runners.name: Richmond Lake
runners.spotlight: 10yo whose 13-race losing sequence goes back to December 2023 but he's run some good races in the meantime (including on soft), most recently staying on for a neck second in the Peter Marsh here (extended 3m1f, good to soft); on that evidence he's well worth a crack at a marathon trip.

runners.comment: Third of 17 in the Welsh National when upped in trip and he's a key player
runners.name: Deafening Silence
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 9yo who was suited by the step up in trip when third of 17 in the Welsh National at Chepstow (3m6f, good to soft) in December; he's won on soft and heavy ground and may well have more to offer over marathon trips; key player.

runners.comment: Patchy form in 2025 but the forecast soft ground could help and he's on a dangerous mark
runners.name: Git Maker
runners.spotlight: 10yo whose form was patchy in 2025 and he was never going well when pulled up in the Welsh National in December (3m6f, good to soft); however, today's forecast soft ground could help and he's 4lb lower than when third in the 2024 Scottish National (4m, soft); not written off in first-time blinkers.

runners.comment: Impressive in the Tommy Whittle here in December but flopped at Doncaster subsequently
runners.name: Grand Geste
runners.spotlight: Impressive when winning the Tommy Whittle here (extended 3m1f, soft) in December and on that evidence today's 10lb higher mark may not be beyond this unexposed 7yo; he's a lot better than he showed at Doncaster (3m, soft) three weeks ago but has something to prove following that flop.

runners.comment: Impressive at Wincanton when the tongue-tie went on and respected despite 9lb rise
runners.name: Rivers Corner
runners.spotlight: Running well in defeat this season, including over an extended 3m4f, before producing a career-best in a first-time tongue-tie to win easily at Wincanton (extended 3m2f, heavy); hit with a 9lb rise but he was impressive last time and could have more to offer in the tongue-tie; respected.

runners.comment: Second of 16 over extended 3m4f at Windsor; progressive and could be in the mix once more
runners.name: Holokea
runners.spotlight: 7yo who has improved for the switch to fences this season, winning at Ffos Las (3m1f, soft) in October and finishing second on his three starts since, most recently behind Neo King in a big field at Windsor (extended 3m4f, soft); progressive and he could be in the mix once more up 3lb for last time.

runners.comment: Kept on for fifth in the Tommy Whittle here and the step up in trip may be a good move
runners.name: Grand Albert
runners.spotlight: He's had jumping issues but was better in that department in first-time cheekpieces (retained) in the Tommy Whittle here (extended 3m1f, soft) in December, and the way he kept on for fifth of 12 behind Grand Geste (beaten about 14l) hints this step up in trip may be a good move; each-way chance.

runners.comment: Won at Windsor in first-time cheekpieces; 9lb higher here but further improvement possible
runners.name: Neo King
runners.spotlight: Built upon previous chasing promise to get off the mark at the seventh attempt over fences in first-time cheekpieces at Windsor last month (extended 3m4f, soft; from Holokea); from out of the handicap he's 9lb higher today but is unexposed in the headgear and further improvement is possible.

15:50.race_name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (Pertemps Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Showed he's still smart when second over C&D in blinkers latest; claims if building on it
runners.name: Stay Away Fay
runners.spotlight: Had struggled badly in recent years but belatedly showed a smart level of ability remains when second over C&D (soft) in first-time blinkers (retained) four weeks ago; put back up 4lb but retains handicapping scope if building on that, with his top stable's good form providing hope that he can.

runners.comment: Better than ever at 9, winning Cheltenham handicap and Sandown Listed race last twice
runners.name: Nurse Susan
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and thriving, better than ever at the age of nine; took hurdles record to 6-11 when winning Listed event at Sandown (2m4f, good; handles soft) six weeks ago; has winning form over as far as 2m7f; commands respect.

runners.comment: Third at Galway in August; hampered and pulled up at Cheltenham since; remains unexposed
runners.name: Chart Topper
runners.owner: Aisling Byrne & Paul Raleigh & Matthew Cunningham
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for third in Listed handicap hurdle at the Galway festival (2m6f, good) in August; looked to be going okay when hampered soon after three out and pulled up sharply in a similar race to this at Cheltenham in October; off since; this soft-ground winner remains fairly unexposed for his top Irish stable.

runners.comment: Two wins last winter but pulled up final start and again on recent reappearance
runners.name: Red Dirt Road
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 9yo; won at Aintree (soft) and Sandown (heavy; made all for an 8l verdict) last winter but pulled up at Uttoxeter on final start and suffered a similar fate on his Sandown reappearance a fortnight ago; needs to have come on a lot in a short time.

runners.comment: Runner-up in series final previous C&D run; second to Go To War at Windsor latest; player
runners.name: Doughmore Bay
runners.spotlight: Placed both hurdle starts since returning from lengthy layoff (pulled up after bad early mistake on chase debut in between), finishing second to reopposing Go To War in a competitive 3m event at Windsor (soft) last time; his previous outing over C&D (also soft) resulted in a very good second in a series final; has to enter calculations.

runners.comment: Off since below-par run over fences at Galway in August and might be best watched
runners.name: Cave Court
runners.spotlight: Has done his winning (four hurdles, two chases) over shorter but he does stay 3m and handle testing ground; however, he's been off since finishing a well-beaten favourite over fences at the Galway festival last summer and a watching brief is probably the call, for all his yard has been among the winners in Britain this week.

runners.comment: Second in novice latest; very interesting handicap newcomer for his much-respected stable
runners.name: Minella Emperor
runners.spotlight: Two bumper wins came on good ground, but he has run well over hurdles on testing ground, including latest 2m6f Thurles novice second; steps up to 3m for his handicap debut; a very interesting contender for his much-respected trainer.

runners.comment: Went close in good handicap last term and could figure if reacting well to wind op
runners.name: Off The Jury
runners.spotlight: Point winner who is yet to get the job done under rules after 11 attempts but has been runner-up five times, including in maiden at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft) 37 days ago; also went close in the always-competitive EBF Final at Sandown last March off only 2lb lower so capable of playing a prominent role if putting his best foot forward after wind surgery (also tongue tied first time).

runners.comment: Fended off Doughmore Bay in similar race at Windsor (soft) last month; off 6lb higher now
runners.name: Go To War
runners.spotlight: Back to form with a bang returned to hurdles when fending off Doughmore Bay in a valuable 3m handicap at Windsor (soft) 27 days ago; allowed to bowl along at the head of affairs in that contest and there's possible competition for the lead from the likes of Red Dirt Road, Stone's Throw and Stay Away Fay here; still no surprise were he to progress again, though.

runners.comment: Won on soft at Doncaster in November but has disappointed at Musselburgh since
runners.name: Serious Chat
runners.spotlight: Resumed his progression with a 2m3f win (has won over 2m7f) on soft at Doncaster in November but needs to shrug off a disappointing effort at Musselburgh on New Year's Day.

runners.comment: Clear with a progressive sort at Wincanton latest so a 6lb rise may not stop him
runners.name: Champagne Chic
runners.spotlight: Has improved for the step up to about 3m and cheekpieces this season, building on his Chepstow second when going one better at Wincanton (heavy) last month; pulled clear with a progressive sort and a 6lb rise may underestimate this low-mileage 6yo.

runners.breeder: Shade Oak Stud & Mr D Jenks
runners.comment: Now 3-4 since stepped up to around 3m; this harder but can't rule out further progress
runners.name: Stones Throw
runners.spotlight: Made it three wins in last four starts since stepped up to around 3m when making all in five-runner handicap at Doncaster just after Christmas; all those successes were achieved on good/good to soft but he did win a bumper on soft at the start of his career; more on his plate off 7lb higher in a much stronger race now but further progress can't be discounted.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: Disappointed on chase debut/return but remains unexposed having rejoined Nicky Richards
runners.name: Jupiter Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground bumper winner for Nicky Richards in March 2024 and followed up in 2m4f Newcastle novice hurdle (soft again) for Lucinda Russell last January; bettered that form in defeat in two subsequent starts at up to 3m last season but disappointed switched to fences on Carlisle reappearance in October; has subsequently rejoined Nicky Richards and remains unexposed.

runners.comment: Decent record in big fields, including Punchestown win last May; below par since
runners.name: Thanksforthehelp
runners.spotlight: Blew apart a 15-runner Pertemps qualifier at Chepstow (2m7f) in February 2023 and underlined how effective he can be in big-field races when seeing off 24 rivals in a handicap at the Punchestown festival (2m3f, yielding) last spring; hasn't come close to reproducing that form in three outings this winter but his mark has eased a little as a result; worth a second look in the betting.

runners.comment: Stepped up to around 3m for handicap career, winning at Navan and third at Fairyhouse
runners.name: Found A Diamond
runners.spotlight: Second hurdle success when stepped up to 3m1f for his Navan handicap debut (soft to heavy) in December and backed that up when third of nine over 3m at Fairyhouse (yielding) since; one of a few unexposed types in this line-up.

runners.breeder: Sc Racing Investment Society Ecurie Ris
runners.comment: The way he powered clear late on at Warwick recently suggests he can do better again
runners.name: Gwennie May Star
runners.spotlight: Won twice in these colours for Dan Skelton last season and good start for the Olly Murphy yard this winter, winning twice over 3m1f at Warwick (soft/good to soft); partnered by Sean Bowen for the first time when powering clear on the run-in three weeks ago and leaves the impression there could be even more to come as his stamina is drawn out; player.

runners.comment: Won two hunter chases in this month last year; fifth at Cheltenham Festival on last start
runners.name: Shearer
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler/chaser who launched hunter chase career with two wins in this month last year (2m5f/2m7f) before a creditable fifth at the Cheltenham Festival (3m2f, good to soft); returns from 11-month absence but still commands respect.

runners.comment: Useful handicapper who made a winning hunter chase debut last month
runners.name: Unexpected Party
runners.spotlight: Useful handicapper who won the Grand Annual Chase at the 2024 Cheltenham Festival (2m, soft) and was second in that race last year (good to soft); did not need to be at best to make winning hunter chase debut at Taunton (2m5f, good; main rival disappointed) last month and ought to remain a potent threat at this level.

runners.comment: Won under rules last season and made satisfactory return in open point; could have a say
runners.name: Lift Me Up
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in Champion Hunters' Chase at Stratford (3m3f, good) in spring 2024 and won under rules at Warwick (3m, good to soft) in January last year; made satisfactory reappearance in open point last month and handles soft ground (unraced on heavy); no surprise if he features.

runners.comment: Ran well when fifth in this race a year ago and has some notable form since
runners.name: Take All
runners.spotlight: Ran well when fifth in this race a year ago (good to soft) and has some notable form since, including fourth of 16 in amateur riders' handicap at Cheltenham (3m1f, heavy) in November and third in recent Ludlow hunter chase (3m, good to soft); can make his presence felt.

runners.comment: Fair on Flat in Ireland and also showed some hurdling ability; back from mammoth absence
runners.name: Darraby
runners.spotlight: Fair on the Flat when trained in Ireland and also showed some hurdling ability there but this stable/chase debut comes after a mammoth absence and he can only be watched.

runners.comment: Long in the tooth now but was still useful last season and has good record when fresh
runners.name: Good Boy Bobby
runners.spotlight: Six-time chase winner; long in the tooth now but was placed in Newbury veterans' chase (3m2f, soft) on latest outing last March and has a good record when fresh; shortlised on hunter chase debut.

runners.comment: Didn't really fulfull potential for Dan Skelton; changed hands after poor run in December
runners.name: Settle Down Jill
runners.spotlight: Won mares' novice hurdle (2m3f, good) for Dan Skelton in October but didn't really fulfill her potential for that stable and has changed hands since running poorly over fences in December; makes stable debut in a useful hunter chase and looks up against it.

12:35.race_name: BetMGM Premier League Darts Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Second on heavy at Leicester latest and he still has potential; respected at this new trip
runners.name: At The Oche
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who landed the odds in a Ffos Las maiden (2m, good) in October; runner-up in two of his three handicaps since, including at Ascot (extended 2m3f) in November and Leicester (1m7f, heavy) last month; only 1lb higher than for that last run and he's respected at this new trip.

runners.comment: Irish point winner but he's 0-6 under rules and was pulled in a chase handicap last time
runners.name: Star Of Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner but he's been expensive to follow under rules (0-6) and was pulled up in a handicap chase at Chepstow (2m7f, soft) last month; has something to prove and he needs a transformation back over hurdles.

runners.comment: Won at 3-1 on handicap debut at Uttoxeter and he's open to more progress; key player
runners.name: Eton Mes
runners.spotlight: Well-held fourth in his first three runs over hurdles but he found improvement when justifying support on handicap debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) three weeks ago; up 5lb but that was a convincing win under Rian Corcoran and he's open to more progress at this new trip; key player.

runners.comment: Quirky sort but he's on a workable mark and is hard to rule out in suitable conditions
runners.name: Looking For Larry
runners.spotlight: Well-backed winner at Exeter (2m5f, soft) last January, on his second run after a long absence; looked a bit of a handful in next two runs but he returned after another layoff with an encouraging effort at Exeter (2m7f, good to soft) last month; continues to edge down the weights and has possibilities if he can build on that last run.

runners.breeder: Sarl Igep Haras Du Chateau De Rabodanges
runners.comment: Tailed off at Wincanton in his last two runs and needs a major revival back over hurdles
runners.name: Thankyouandplease
runners.spotlight: Won a heavy-ground handicap at Leicester (1m7f) in December but he's finished tailed off at Wincanton (1m7f/2m4f) in his last two runs; didn't jump well on his chase debut last time but he needs a major revival back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Tailed off over fences last time and he comes with risks attached back over hurdles
runners.name: Moonlight Artist
runners.owner: The Cheltenham & South West Racing Club
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-10 over hurdles and has the same strike-rate over fences; his last success was in a chase handicap at Warwick (3m, good) last April but he's not matched that form since and was tailed off at Exeter last time; comes with risks attached after a break and his last hurdle run was 12 months ago.

runners.comment: Unexposed 5yo but he needs improvement back up in trip on handicap debut
runners.name: Charlies Jetaway
runners.spotlight: Placed in two points last May but he's struggled at big prices in three hurdle runs (2m-2m5f) this winter; still unexposed and this is more realistic on handicap debut but he needs improvement back up in trip; stablemate of Thankyouandplease.

13:05.race_name: BetMGM Agatha Christie Mares' Novices' Chase (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Tough front-runner who is 2-4 over fences and sets a clear standard here; strong claims
runners.name: Bluey
runners.spotlight: Front-runner, who made it 2-4 over fences with a brave win a Class 2 handicap at Windsor (2m4f, soft; first run after wind surgery) last month; sets the standard on that form and she's open to more progress on this drop back in trip; strong contender.

runners.comment: Won at Ffos Las last time but that was a minor handicap and this is a tough task
runners.name: Followango
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner, who made the breakthrough over fences at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) two weeks ago but that was a minor handicap and she has lots to find back at 2m in this Listed race.

runners.comment: Irish raider who has struggled in Grade 2 events last twice; needs to get back on track
runners.name: Kilbarry Saint
runners.owner: Mrs Con OKeeffe & Tadhg OSullivan & Anthony OKeeffe
runners.spotlight: Best effort in ambitious campaign last season when beaten only one length by subsequent Arkle second Only By Night at Exeter (2m1f, good to soft); looks interesting on that form but she's struggled in Grade 2 events in last two runs and needs to revive on this drop back in class.

runners.comment: Well held in a Listed race at Newbury last time and this is another tough task back at 2m
runners.name: Presenting A Queen
runners.spotlight: Bumper/hurdles winner; has some place form over fences but she was a well-held fourth of five in a mares' Listed event at Newbury (2m7f, good to soft; 33-1) last month; this looks another tough assignment and she's not run over 2m for a long time; first-time visor replaces blinkers.

runners.comment: Dual Listed winner (bumper/hurdle) who is unexposed over fences and has claims back at 2m
runners.name: Queens Gamble
runners.spotlight: Dual Listed winner (bumper/hurdle), who is unexposed over fences and ran well for a long way when third of six in a Musselburgh handicap (2m4f, good to soft) 13 days ago; wasn't far off her best with that promising effort and she's respected on this drop back in trip.

runners.comment: Five-time hurdle winner but she's 0-4 over fences and this is a tough task on the figures
runners.name: Sunday Soldier
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner who is 0-4 over fences; ran respectably in a hurdle handicap at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) last month but this is a tough task on the figures and she fell over fences on her penultimate run; passed over.

runners.breeder: B Decouz & S C E A Du Bas Bugey
runners.comment: Six Grade 2 wins and he ran respectably in Grade 1 latest; respected dropped back in class
runners.name: Rubaud
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who is 2-3 since returned to hurdles from fences, winning races at Kempton (Listed) and Wincanton (Elite Hurdle) that he also took in 2023 and 2024; held in a 9l third at Kempton on Boxing Day but that was behind Sir Gino in a Grade 1 and he's strongly respected on this drop back in class; most of his wins have been on good ground but he's effective on soft.

runners.comment: Upwardly mobile 6yo who sets the standard on his latest form and is open to more progress
runners.name: Alexei
runners.spotlight: Upwardly mobile 6yo who completed a double in the Greatwood at Cheltenham (2m, soft) in November and was creditable third under topweight in another valuable handicap at Ascot (1m7f, good to soft) in December; now steps up into a Grade 2 event but he sets the standard on his latest form and is open to more progress; leading contender.

runners.comment: Returns to hurdling for new yard and this is a daunting task after 139 days off
runners.name: Intellotto
runners.spotlight: Flat, chase and dual hurdle winner for Joseph O'Brien but he was out of sorts under both codes in his final two runs in Ireland; now returns to hurdling for new yard and this is a daunting task after 139 days off; blinkers worn last time are removed.

runners.comment: Overall record of 5-12 but this looks a tough assignment after a year off
runners.name: Secret Squirrel
runners.spotlight: Overall record of 5-12, including three wins at around 2m over hurdles (good to soft/soft); his last win was at Windsor last January but he fell at the last in a major handicap at Newbury the following month and has been on the sidelines since; has something to prove after a year off and this looks tough on the figures.

14:11.race_name: BetMGM King Of The Golden Darts "National Hunt" Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Well held in both hurdle runs but he's a possible improver after wind surgery; tongue tied
runners.name: Caballero Cliff
runners.spotlight: Ran a big race at a big price when fourth of 17 in last season's Champion Bumper at Cheltenham (good to soft); well held in two hurdle runs this season but he had wind surgery in December and tongue-tie is now added; still early days in this sphere and he's a possible improver back from a short break.

runners.comment: Bumper winner but was pulled up in a French hurdle when last seen 12 months ago
runners.name: Full Force Gale
runners.spotlight: Won at Ffos Las (good to soft) in the first of his two bumpers but was pulled up in a French hurdle (3-1 favourite) when last seen 12 months ago; has questions to answer on his comeback but interesting to see if money arrives for him again.

runners.comment: Well held in both bumpers and tailed off in two hurdle runs (2m3f) this winter
runners.name: King Sacre
runners.spotlight: Well held in both bumpers and tailed off at massive prices in two hurdle runs (2m3f, good to soft) this winter.

runners.comment: Won a bumper here and he was close second on hurdling debut at Sedgefield; respected
runners.name: Marhaba Prince
runners.spotlight: Won the first of his three bumpers and that was on soft at this track; turned over at short odds on hurdle debut at Sedgefield (2m4f, soft) in December but he was only narrowly denied in a clear second; that was a promising start in this sphere and he's respected on this drop back in trip.

runners.comment: Tailed off in two hurdle runs over C&D last month and can only be watched
runners.name: Richforadaay
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete in three of his four points and he finished tailed off in two hurdle runs over C&D (soft/heavy) last month; opposable.

runners.comment: Has had some tough tasks over hurdles but he sets the standard back in calmer waters
runners.name: The Egyptian Ginge
runners.spotlight: Went close in his final two bumpers last season and wasn't beaten far when last of five in good 4yo hurdle at Cheltenham (2m; first time hood) in October; well held in both subsequent runs but the first was a Grade 2 at Haydock and latest was behind a smart prospect at Kempton; this is more realistic back in calmer waters and he has leading claims on his best form.

runners.comment: Struggled on hurdling debut at Chepstow and she could be one for longer trips later on
runners.name: Cue Jump
runners.spotlight: Placed in three of her four points but she was beaten 46l at a big price on hurdling debut at Chepstow (2m, soft) last month; has good jumping pedigree but she could be one for longer trips later on.

runners.comment: Just 1-9 in points and she's probably best watched on rules debut
runners.name: Dunaden Island
runners.spotlight: Just 1-9 in points and she failed to complete on five occasions; returns after 279 days off and is probably best watched on rules debut.

runners.comment: Tailed off at 25-1 in a maiden hurdle on Taunton debut (2m, good to soft) last month
runners.name: Gilded Glance
runners.spotlight: The only runner without experience in a maiden hurdle at Taunton (2m, good to soft) last month but she was always behind and finished tailed off at 25-1; should know more this time but she needs to leave that initial form a long way behind.

runners.comment: First signs of ability before unseating three out here (2m5f) last month; hard to weigh up
runners.name: Miss Jaffa Cake
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete in two points; completely tailed off in first two hurdle runs but she was making some headway when she unseated three out here (2m5f, heavy) on her reappearance last month; showed signs of ability in that race but this is a different test back at this trip and others are preferred.

runners.comment: Struggled in two bumpers and same story in three hurdle runs this winter
runners.name: Mistress Fox
runners.spotlight: Struggled at big prices in two bumpers and same story in three hurdle runs on testing ground this winter.

14:50.race_name: No One's As Vegas As BetMGM Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 3-9 over fences but he's lost his way in last two runs and needs to get back on track
runners.name: Pilsdon Pen
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-7 over fences with narrow win on his C&D reappearance (good to soft) in December; only 1lb higher here but he's been disappointing since that last success and was pulled up at Exeter (first-time blinkers) last time; regular cheekpieces are now reapplied but he needs to get back in track.

runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he's not easy to predict and was pulled up here last time; risky
runners.name: Pedley Wood
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row at Wincanton (2m4f/3m1f) last winter and latest was off 1lb lower on heavy ground; looks interesting on that form but he's been up and down since and was pulled up here on Boxing Day; needs to bounce back again after that and he comes with risks attached.

runners.comment: Returned to form when scoring at Exeter last month and he's respected back up in trip
runners.name: Bonza Boy
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he returned to form when scoring at Exeter (2m1f, good to soft) last month; back up 4lb in the weights but he remains feasibly treated and his penultimate win was over an extended 2m3f on soft ground; respected.

runners.breeder: J Breton F Breton & B Beaunez
runners.comment: Unexposed chaser who won by 7l in the mud at Exeter (2m3f) last time; strong contender
runners.name: Saint Cyr De Pail
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner who is unexposed over fences and he really got his act together when winning at Exeter (2m3f, heavy) in December; up 7lb but that was a clear personal best last time and he's open to more progress; big player.

runners.comment: Runner-up at Lingfield on penultimate run and he's in the mix off dangerous mark
runners.name: Jeu dOpale
runners.spotlight: Won 2m2f chase in France in 2022 but missed 2023 and 2024; best effort for current was a second back over fences at Lingfield (2m, good to soft) in December and it wasn't his fault when he fell early on at Leicester (got hampered) last month; conditions should be fine here and he's in the mix off a dangerous mark.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 10yo who was won two of her last three including over C&D latest; respected
runners.name: Mutley Crew
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 10yo, who has form figures of 121 this winter and that last win was by 7l over C&D (heavy) two weeks ago; up 8lb but she was as good as ever last time and is now 2-5 over fences; interesting contender.

runners.comment: On workable mark but he didn't fire last time and his last win was two years ago
runners.name: Valirann Gold
runners.spotlight: Some creditable efforts towards the end of last year, including when runner-up behind Saint Cyr De Pail at Exeter (2m3f, heavy); has a swing in the weights with his old rival but he didn't fire at Taunton last time and his last win was two years ago.

15:23.race_name: BetMGM Who Wants A Nine-Darter Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Went close at Exeter last month but he was disappointing when favourite at Hereford latest
runners.name: Royal Mer
runners.spotlight: Five-time chase winner who relishes testing ground; runner-up in his first two starts this season including a close call at Exeter (2m1f, good to soft), but his form cooled at Hereford last time; needs to step up again after that but he remains well treated on his old form.

runners.comment: Consistent sort but he had a blip last time and he's never raced at shorter than 2m3f
runners.name: Joe Cotton
runners.spotlight: Won at Fontwell (2m3f, good) last March and he finished in the first three in his next five starts; still looks on workable mark but he had a rare blip at Windsor (2m6f, soft) last month and he's never raced at shorter than 2m3f; bit to prove and others are preferred.

runners.breeder: E U R L Agb Agency & Mrs D Billebaut
runners.comment: Unexposed chaser who was a front-running second at Taunton last time; shortlisted
runners.name: Jack Black
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but he ran his best race so far when front-running second in a chase handicap at Taunton (2m, good to soft; cheekpieces added) last month; that was only his second run over fences and he's a big player if he can build on that.

runners.comment: Ran well for a long way at Uttoxeter in December and he's in the mix in new headgear
runners.name: Better Off Alone
runners.spotlight: Ran well against a hotpot in 2m7f hurdle at Lingfield (soft) last January; pulled up in first two chases but he wasn't too far away at Uttoxeter (2m4f, heavy; first run since wind surgery) in December, where a couple of late mistakes spoiled an otherwise sound round of jumping; blinkers are now tried and he needs a close look after another break.

runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he's been well held in last three runs; needs to get back on track
runners.name: Wewillgowithplanb
runners.spotlight: Effective at 2m on heavy ground but his last win was two years ago; well handicapped on old form but he's been well held in his last three runs and needs to get back on track.

runners.comment: Two chase wins in France but he's been well held in both runs for current yard
runners.name: Raffles Hermes
runners.spotlight: Won twice over fences in France; joined this yard for 30,000euros but he's been well held at Exeter (2m3f) and Taunton (2m) in his two runs this winter; still has low mileage but he needs to raise his game.

runners.comment: Won here (2m4f) on Boxing Day but he's not matched that in two runs since; new headgear
runners.name: Begin The Luck
runners.spotlight: 10yo who was consistent towards the end of last year and posted his fifth chase win when scoring here (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; only 1lb higher than for that win but he's been well held in two subsequent runs and needs new headgear to give him a boost.

16:00.race_name: Bet £10 Get £40 With BetMGM Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Unexposed chaser who won this last year and he's respected on this big drop back in grade
runners.name: Saladins Son
runners.spotlight: Won two C&D handicaps (soft/good to soft) early last year and the first leg was in this race; two creditable frame efforts in Class 2 events at Haydock this season and he may have paid the price for getting involved in a duel with a major improver last time; still unexposed over fences and he's an interesting contender on this big drop back in grade.

runners.comment: 3-9 over fences but he's been pulled up in last three runs; needs a major revival
runners.name: Take Your Time
runners.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner who is 3-9 over fences but he's been pulled up in last three runs and latest was over C&D (heavy) two weeks ago; that was after a lengthy absence but he's now an 11yo and he needs a big turnaround.

runners.comment: Four-time chase winner who was a clear second at Market Rasen last time; in the mix
runners.name: Concetto
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner for Greenall-Guerriero stable; has a patchy record but he's run well in two of his three starts for current yard, including a clear second at Market Rasen (3m, soft) last month; has claims if he can back that up and his last win was off 1lb higher.

runners.comment: Ended last season with two wins and he needs close look on his comeback
runners.name: Camulus
runners.spotlight: Made his breakthrough in a chase handicap at Leicester (2m6f, soft) last January and he completed a double at Taunton (2m7f, good to soft) the following month; has been absent since then but he still looks feasibly treated and should have more to offer in this sphere; needs a close look on comeback.

runners.comment: 12yo who has struggled in his two runs this winter and he needs to turn things around
runners.name: Supervisor
runners.owner: Mrs Julia Young And Venetia Williams
runners.spotlight: 12yo who has struggled at biggish prices in his two runs over 2m7f at Chepstow (tailed off/pulled up) this winter; dropped another 4lb but his last win was in April 2024 and he needs a major revival; stablemate of Camulus.

runners.comment: 0-7 over fences but is in form; placed at Chepstow yesterday; on a workable mark
runners.name: Astronomic View
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner who is 0-7 over fences but is in form, having been placed at Ffos Las (close second; jumped left) two weeks ago and Chepstow yesterday, both over about 3m; feasibly treated off current mark.

runners.comment: 10yo who made it 2-5 over fences when scoring in good style at Fontwell; respected
runners.name: Cooleenymore
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 14 starts over hurdles but she made it 2-5 over fences when scoring at Fontwell (3m2f, soft) last month; up 6lb but that was a comfortable success and she's respected on this drop back in trip.

16:37.race_name: Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Scored cosily at Exeter (2m7f) last month; up 4lb but has more to offer so a big player
runners.name: Call Me Legend
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage son of Milan who has improved with each of his three runs in handicaps, cosily scoring at Exeter (2m7f, good to soft) last month; up 4lb but he has more to offer at staying trips and rates a big player.

runners.comment: Yet to get his head in front and just a fair fourth at Warwick latest; no forlorn hope
runners.name: Seatoit
runners.owner: Julie And David R Martin And Dan Hall
runners.spotlight: Yet to get his head in front and he didn't look the easiest of rides when a fair fourth of nine in 3m1f Warwick handicap 22 days ago, hanging left late on; still no forlorn hope off the same mark.

runners.comment: Good fourth on handicap debut at Exeter latest; he's one to consider here
runners.name: Crossgales King
runners.spotlight: Kingston Hill gelding who is progressing with experience in this sphere, posting a good fourth of seven to Call Me Legend on his handicap debut at Exeter (2m7f, good to soft) last month; enjoys a 4lb weights pull here so is one to consider.

runners.comment: Easy winner over fences at Ludlow but only fifth at Huntingdon since; still not ruled out
runners.name: Annie Express
