runners.spotlight: Made light of a 20-month absence for her new yard when scoring easily over fences at Ludlow (3m) in January; failed to back that up turned out a week later when fifth of eight in 3m Huntingdon handicap chase; still not ruled out back in this sphere with cheekpieces refitted.

runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late Mrs B E Moore
runners.comment: Resurgent third at Chepstow last month; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb
runners.name: Dont Tell Rosie
runners.spotlight: Had her usual hood left off when a resurgent third of ten in 2m4f Chepstow handicap hurdle last month; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb in her bid for a maiden victory.

runners.comment: Very good fourth of 11 in 2m4f handicap here 16 days ago; shortlisted eased 1lb here
runners.name: Badentaggart
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 7yo who hinted at promise before posting an excellent fourth of 11 in 2m4f handicap here 16 days ago; he can make his presence felt eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Remote fourth of seven in 3m1f Hereford handicap last month; others appeal more
runners.name: Bredon Hill Dart
runners.owner: R W And Mrs Mitchell D V Gardner
runners.spotlight: Finally got off the mark at Newton Abbot (3m2f) last June but lightly raced since and came in a remote fourth of seven in 3m1f Hereford handicap last month; others appeal more.

12:50.race_name: Join The Midnite Movement Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.breeder: Oghill House Sledmere Stud & D Hyland
runners.comment: Leicester win last October was for this rider; should be staying on if they go hard early
runners.name: Johnny Boom
runners.spotlight: Ran out the convincing winner of a 1m2f handicap at Leicester in October (absent 385 days; for this rider); only midfield at Kempton ten days ago but it wasn't a bad run; this race has the potential to be well run and he could be arriving on the scene late.

runners.comment: Went close off this mark in September (for today's rider); wind op since latest; e-w shout
runners.name: Roland Garros
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but he went close on his stable debut at Haydock in September (11.5f, good; ridden by Fletcher Yarham) and races off the same mark here; had a wind operation following some heavy defeats (Flat and hurdles) and now fitted with cheekpieces; may have other pace influences to deal with but he returns to action with his yard in good form.

runners.comment: Hasn't progressed in handicaps but down in weights and Simon Walker booked; can't dismiss
runners.name: Kathleen Mary
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who hasn't progressed since moving into handicaps; edging down the weights and has the assistance of Simon Walker in the saddle so too soon to be giving up on her.

runners.comment: Bumped into an in-form rival when heavily backed 12 days ago; remains of interest
runners.name: Shahbaz
runners.spotlight: Struggled early on for this yard (at huge prices) but he was dropped into a Class 6 at Wolverhampton (1m4f) 12 days ago, backed into 11-8 favouritism and duly returned to form, finding only an in-form rival too good; 1lb rise not an issue given what he was capable of last year; key player.

runners.comment: 1m2f course win in December; solid runs in defeat since; big run on the cards
runners.name: Bownder
runners.spotlight: 1m2f winner here in December and that has been followed by three solid runs in defeat; inexperienced amateur seeking his first winner but he looked polished in a handful of rides in 2025 and could be good value for the 7lb claim; high on the list.

runners.comment: Three solid efforts since returned to AW; conditions fine & top amateur booked; contender
runners.name: Voix De Bocelli
runners.spotlight: He has finished third in all three starts since returning to the AW, two of them over C&D; has a leading amateur booked and another big run looks on the cards.

runners.comment: Three turf wins last year; absent since August and she'll need to be at her best on return
runners.name: Sea Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Three handicap wins at around this trip on turf last season; not seen to best effect at Brighton when last seen in August; effective at the track but may come on for this reappearance.

runners.comment: Seemed to run well here last month (1m2f) but not obviously well treated now handicapping
runners.name: Imperial Decision
runners.spotlight: Achieved his best RPR when last of three in a 1m2f maiden here last month but the field crawled through the first half mile and it doesn't look persuasive form; moves into handicaps with the potential for better but opening mark looks tough enough.

runners.comment: Gambled on when making a winning stable debut on Sunday; this is tougher and 1m4f a query
runners.name: Man Is King
runners.spotlight: Beaten 41 times in Ireland but he landed a gamble in a 1m2f classified event at Chelmsford on his stable debut on Sunday; no fluke about that success but this is a better race and he didn't convince with his stamina in one previous attempt at the trip.

13:25.race_name: BetMGM Supports Safer Gambling Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Improved when 2nd to good prospect at Kempton last month (1m); bred to stay; sets standard
runners.name: Al Azd
runners.spotlight: In need of the experience in two 7f turf runs as a 2yo, after which he was gelded; took a good step forward when second to an impressive stablemate of Into The Light at Kempton 17 days ago (1m); well positioned in a steadily-run race on that occasion but it was still a useful effort and he is bred to do better over this extra 2f; solid claims.

runners.comment: Dam a Listed-winner over 15.5f in France; top stable; a newcomer of some interest
runners.name: Into The Light
runners.spotlight: First foal of a 1m4f-15.5f winner (including French Listed; RPR 98), herself from a good family; stable always to be feared in this type of event and although he will stay further in time, he is a newcomer of interest.

runners.comment: RPR of just 43 in two 1m runs last month; significant improvement required
runners.name: Dors Dazzler
runners.spotlight: RPR of just 43 in two 1m maiden runs on Polytrack last month; some encouragement for 1m2f on breeding but improvement is essential.

runners.comment: Promise in two Tapeta runs (1m3f and 9.5f) this winter; can do better but she needs to
runners.name: Kindly Queen
runners.spotlight: She has looked a work in progress in her two runs on Tapeta this winter (1m3f and 9.5f); open to improvement but it will be needed.

runners.comment: Promise in two 1m runs at Kempton but she'll need plenty more for the new trip to win here
runners.name: Virtue Chastity
runners.spotlight: Both this winter's Kempton runs (1m) have offered hope of better but she will need a good step forward for the longer trip if she is to come out on top today.

14:00.race_name: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Course win (turf) last summer; not fully exposed but absent five months and drawn wide
runners.name: Sandscreendeliverd
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when landing a 5f handicap on the turf course here last August; subsequent Sandown disappointment easily excusable on account of the soft ground; not fully exposed and showed promise on AW (Tapeta) for former yard; tricky draw and five-month absence to contend with today.

runners.comment: Often races too freely; blew the start latest; capable but carries risk
runners.name: Cayman Tai
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 17 starts, often compromising his chance by refusing to settle; tried in a hood last time but fluffed the start and still raced freely; tumbling down the weights but a risky proposition back at 5f.

runners.comment: On losing run of 15 but down in grade and well drawn to attack; leading contender
runners.name: Mc Loven
runners.spotlight: Losing run stands at 15 and a few fingers have been burned during that spell but this speedy front-runner is well up to winning off this mark; back at his optimum trip this afternoon and drops into 0-70 company; ideally drawn and a big run looks on the cards.

runners.comment: On a handy mark but not found his best form this winter; returns to 5f today
runners.name: Distant Rumble
runners.spotlight: Last spring's Windsor win (6f, good to firm) came off a 2lb higher mark; running okay this winter without being at his best; drops in trip and grade; not dismissed.

runners.comment: Ready C&D win last month before a good third off this mark on Monday; should go well
runners.name: Thecoffeepoddotco
runners.spotlight: She had been threatening prior to breaking her duck in a C&D handicap (Hello Luna second) last month; ended up challenging wide when a close third at Wolverhampton on Monday (hung right) and that effort suggested this mark was still in range; respected.

runners.comment: Series of good runs since 5f win in November; rider's claim useful; one to consider
runners.name: Beaumadier
runners.spotlight: String of good efforts following his Wolverhampton win in November, the latest when fourth of nine (behind Thecoffeepoddotco) at Wolverhampton on Monday; rider's 7lb claim useful; each-way shout.

runners.comment: Conditions ideal and arrives in good order; unlikely to dominate today though
runners.name: Micks Spirit
runners.spotlight: Multiple C&D winner, the latest when beating Beaumadier last month; not in quite the same form last time and he will do well to lead in today's field.

runners.comment: 4lb better off for 1.25l with Thecoffeepoddotco on latest C&D run; poorly drawn this time
runners.name: Hello Luna
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on her reappearance run (6f) when chasing home Thecoffeepoddotco over C&D 16 days ago; a 4lb turnaround might not be sufficient though and she hasn't fared well on the draw front.

runners.comment: Weights pull with Thecoffeepoddotco/Hello Luna on latest C&D run; others still appeal more
runners.name: Honour Your Dreams
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race for new connections when third over C&D 16 days ago; better off at the weights with both Thecoffeepoddotco and Hello Luna but could prove vulnerable once more.

runners.comment: 50-1 C&D win over last month but ran a lacklustre race last week; new headgear today
runners.name: Manhattan Chute
runners.owner: J May R L Field W Trenchard J Pook
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 50-1 surprise over C&D last month but ran a lacklustre race at Kempton last week; hopes rest on the return to this C&D and addition of a visor reviving him.

runners.comment: Strong finish to win over C&D last week; up 5lb but unexposed at a mile
runners.name: Elouises Prince
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 25-1 surprise over C&D last week (Way To Dubai fourth) when staying on well in the closing stages; not sure to be in the same form again but he is unexposed at a mile and will be a danger to all if in the same form.

runners.comment: Running well over C&D this winter; should make another bold bid
runners.name: Way To Dubai
runners.spotlight: In good form here this winter, winning over C&D two weeks ago and fourth to Elouise's Prince last week; should make another bold bid.

runners.comment: Beaten in two handicaps since a wide-margin maiden win; needs to raise his game
runners.name: Gennadius
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin win in a weak maiden at Chelmsford last month (1m); beaten in two handicaps since and he needs to raise his game.

runners.comment: Inconsistent for H Morrison but dangerous mark on best form; hooded for stable debut
runners.name: Dalmally
runners.spotlight: 1m maiden win for Hughie Morrison in October 2024; runner-up at Windsor last September (1m) when rated 2lb higher; two lesser efforts followed and he changed hands for 2,000gns in November; freegoing sort who could benefit from the addition of a hood; tongue-tie also added; not discounted.

runners.comment: Chance on last season's best form; returning to 1m needs to give him a lift though
runners.name: Dakota Power
runners.spotlight: Bits of form last year that bring him into the reckoning off his reduced mark; return to 1m may help but others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: Well beaten in two handicaps after a 328-day absence; down in weights but risky for now
runners.name: Kev
runners.spotlight: Promise last winter; absent for 328 days prior to his Kempton reappearance in December; well beaten there, and again last month, and he is risky despite his reduced mark.

runners.comment: Back to last winning mark; promising run at Chelmsford; now gets headgear for first time
runners.name: Union Island
runners.spotlight: Reeled off a hat-trick on turf last summer at around 1m; running himself back into form on AW this winter, most recently third of eight at Chelmsford last month; cheekpieces now added; contender.

runners.comment: Running okay this winter but he will need more if he's to win now back up in class
runners.name: Pitney
runners.spotlight: Running respectably on AW this winter and continues to edge down the weights; he will need to pull out a bit more to win in this grade though.

runners.comment: Struggling badly on AW this winter; down in the weights but plenty to prove
runners.name: Comedian Leader
runners.spotlight: Out of sorts on AW this winter, most recently last of nine over 7f here last week; tumbling down the weights but offering little to think she was ready to capitalise.

runners.comment: Useful 2yo; faced stiff tasks in 2025; not ruled out on stable/handicap debut
runners.name: Benevento
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo (Listed winner) and ran some fair races in the face of stiff tasks as a 3yo; gelded during his 217-day absence; makes his handicap/stable debut and still brings relatively low mileage.

runners.comment: Slow starts have crept in and unable to overcome them in good company; dangerous mark
runners.name: Wiltshire
runners.spotlight: Has bundles of ability but slow starts have become a feature and he hasn't been able to get away with it in good company; latest Newcastle effort offered hope of a revival and he has won over 7f in the past; handicapped to win and one to keep a close eye on, especially with Newcastle on Good Friday in mind.

runners.comment: Veteran but in the form of his life this winter; should remain competitive
runners.name: Legal Reform
runners.spotlight: Into the veteran stage but in the form of his life this winter, finishing third over C&D before a Wolverhampton win and a Southwell second; likely vulnerable to an improver but should give his running again.

runners.comment: On a lowly mark but inconsistent nowadays; new visor needs to turn things around
runners.name: Willem Twee
runners.spotlight: Good runs few and far between since August 2024; should be well handicapped but that has been the case for a while and he hasn't shown much this year; now tried in a visor; stable also run Heathcliff.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs P Hopper Mr & Mrs M Morris
runners.comment: Close 3rd last time in Kempton handicap that represents very strong form; same mark; solid
runners.name: Heathcliff
runners.spotlight: Reliable performer at 6f/7f; beaten a neck and a head into third at Kempton last month and probably fortunate to have his mark left unchanged given the strength of that form (second, fourth and fifth won next time and the winner went close too); below his best in one visit to Lingfield but it was early in his career; dangerous.

runners.comment: C&D win last month but in Class 4; well held in 6f Class 2 on Wednesday
runners.name: Tiger Crusade
runners.spotlight: Arrived late on the scene to win over C&D last month; well held in a 6f Class 2 at Kempton on Wednesday; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Behind Tiger Crusade over C&D last month; headgear now absent; others appeal more
runners.name: Best Rate
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name after 15 starts; has some strong handicap form but he finished behind Tiger Crusade over C&D last month and the headgear experiment is now aborted.

runners.comment: Three solid runs in handicaps but he'll need today's change of headgear to spark extra
runners.name: Ebn Sabt
runners.spotlight: Three creditable efforts since moving into handicaps but he will need the change of headgear to have a positive effect if he is to defy this mark.

runners.comment: Easy win at Chelmsford on Sunday (1m); solid claims under a penalty
runners.name: Whos On First
runners.spotlight: No impact in his first handicap but he proved a different proposition at Chelmsford on Sunday (1m), making the running and surging clear in the final furlong; looks well in under a penalty and Jack Dace's claim helps offset it; leading contender.

runners.comment: Flopped on handicap debut (9.5f) two weeks ago; needs to leave that well behind
runners.name: Angry Ant
runners.spotlight: Some promise in maiden/novice company but she finished tailed off on her handicap debut two weeks ago (9.5f); too early to write off but has a point to prove for now.

runners.comment: Unlucky in running over 6f last month; stamina for 1m has to be taken on trust
runners.name: Corniche Girl
runners.owner: C Munro Mrs M Gander And Partner
runners.spotlight: The winner of one of her 12 starts, a 6f nursery at Kempton last August; some good runs in defeat have followed, including when meeting trouble at Wolverhampton 19 days ago, but stamina for 1m has to be taken on trust.

runners.comment: Improved for 1m/handicaps this year but he was left trailing by Who's On First on Sunday
runners.name: Aneirins Sword
runners.spotlight: Formfigures of 122 since upped to 1m and tackling handicaps; left trailing by Who's On First at Chelmsford on Sunday though and a 6lb turnaround may be insufficient to reverse the placings.

runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo who won well over C&D last month; not missed with 6lb rise but can't ignore
runners.name: Uncle Nader
runners.spotlight: He has improved for the step up to 1m, application of headgear and switch to handicaps, finishing second at Chelmsford in November (blinkered) before going one better over C&D last month (cheekpieces, retained); that was an authoritative display and although a 6lb rise asks a stiffer question, he may be up to the task.

runners.comment: No progress for handicapping as yet; return to 1m can help and edging down the weights
runners.name: Prancy Peer
runners.spotlight: No progress for the switch to handicaps on her last two starts; edging down the weights and returning to 1m can help but others arrive with more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and ran well here last month; up 2lb but should be in the mix
runners.name: Mart
runners.spotlight: His best recent efforts have come over this C&D, latterly bumping into a well-handicapped rival 16 days ago; a 2lb nudge up the weights isn't ideal but likely to give his running.

runners.comment: Down in weights and not beaten far over 5f last month; one to consider
runners.name: Diamond Dreamer
runners.spotlight: His last three wins have come over 5f but he is fully effective at this trip and he's slipped below his last winning mark; not beaten far at Chelmsford last month and should give his running.

runners.comment: Four 6f wins in the second half of 2025; less good upped to Class 5 latest; absent 72 days
runners.name: Due Date
runners.owner: A Bangs & Miss J A Challen
runners.spotlight: Four 6f wins in the second half of 2025; came up short in a Class 5 at Chelmsford when last seen 72 days ago; looks high in the weights now.

runners.comment: Met trouble in bid for four-timer here 16 days ago; career best needed but not impossible
runners.name: All Too Beautiful
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to AW this winter, winning at Chelmsford in November and adding C&D wins on her next two starts; met trouble in her bid for a four-timer here 16 days ago; needs a career best to defy this mark but it is not out of the question.

runners.comment: Improving sprinter; 3lb rise for latest C&D win unlikely to prove beyond him
runners.name: Combustion
runners.spotlight: Won four on the bounce in the first half of 2025; still improving judged on his two runs back from an eight-month break, third at Wolverhampton before winning a Class 6 over C&D 38 days ago; that form looks solid enough and a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.

runners.comment: 6f win at Southwell in December has been followed by two poor runs; new headgear today
runners.name: Ottawa
runners.spotlight: Back to form with a 6f win at Southwell in December but he has followed it with two lesser efforts; tries new headgear this afternoon.

runners.comment: Latest C&D run was a bit better but he still has more to prove than his rivals
runners.name: Stapleford Park
runners.spotlight: Struggled for Charlie Fellowes last year and no sign of a full revival in three runs for new stable; others are more convincing.

runners.comment: 0-17 but good fourth at Southwell latest; effective at this longer trip so shortlisted
runners.name: Forest Caper
runners.spotlight: 0-17 but he got right back on track when fourth of 11 in 1m Southwell handicap nine days ago, doing best of those held up off a steady pace; he's effective at this longer trip and is one for the shortlist.

runners.comment: Winless since 2024 and he's been off for four months since beating only one home over C&D
runners.name: Up The Jazz
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2024 and he's been off the track for four months since beating only one home over C&D; he needs to hit the ground running.

runners.comment: In good form, fifth in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap 19 days ago; possibilities eased 1lb
runners.name: Golspie
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways over C&D in December and has continued in good form since, fifth of ten in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap last month; possibilities eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Solid third at Wolverhampton 12 days ago; must enter calculations with a hood added
runners.name: Mao Shang Wong
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 4yo who posted a solid third of ten on just his second go in handicap company at Wolverhampton (8.5f) 12 days ago; he can race off a 1lb lower mark here so must enter calculations with a hood added.

runners.comment: Not seen to ideal effect when C&D fourth latest; this course specialist is a likely player
runners.name: Prince Achille
runners.spotlight: Bagged a fifth C&D victory in November and in good nick subsequently, not seen to ideal effect when fourth of 11 back over C&D 25 days ago; a likely player eased 1lb.

runners.comment: C&D winner who got back on track when third at Southwell 25 days ago; needs considering
runners.name: Bearwith
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who got back on track when third of seven in 1m3f Southwell handicap 25 days ago; he needs considering off a 1lb lower mark.

runners.comment: On a losing sequence and he's been well below par over C&D and at Kempton last two runs
runners.name: Jack Sparowe
runners.spotlight: On a losing sequence and he's been well below par since returning from three months off over C&D and in 1m3f Kempton handicap ten days ago; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Last at Kempton on final run for Tom Ward in October; needs yard switch to spark progress
runners.name: Lieutenant Lily
runners.spotlight: Showed some fair form when placed (around 1m2f) last spring but she failed to go on in handicaps and trailed in last of ten at Kempton (1m3f) on her final run for Tom Ward in October; since changed hands for 3,000gns and needs this yard switch to spark a resurgence on her Tapeta debut.

runners.comment: Off the mark over C&D before a good C&D third three weeks ago; can make her presence felt
runners.name: Star Cast
runners.spotlight: Finally opened her account over C&D in January and backed it up with a good third of 11 back over C&D three weeks ago; she can make her presence felt again.

runners.comment: 4-5 this year, all over C&D, the latest by 0.5l on Tuesday; 6lb higher; should go well

runners.spotlight: Has won four of his five races, all over C&D, this year, his latest win coming last Tuesday when getting home by 0.5l; up 6lb but has won off higher marks in the past; should go well

runners.comment: Ex-Irish 6f maiden winner; encouraging stable/AW debut when fourth last month; chance

runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; won a 6f Curragh maiden last March (soft) but proved disappointing in handicaps after that; encouraging AW/stable debut when fourth of 11 over 7f at Wolverhampton last month; that was her first run since October, so should fare better this time, particularly back at 6f; a chance.

runners.comment: Three C&D wins; two good C&D runs off this mark after a break in October; a possible
runners.name: Raft Up
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner; two good C&D seconds off this mark following a break in October; not run since December, but not out of it.

runners.comment: Easy C&D win after a break last year and could go well on his first run since November
runners.name: Andalprofit
runners.spotlight: Produced a career-best when an easy winner of a C&D handicap on return to action last April (back from a 201-day break); gained another success at Redcar in November (6f, good); could go well back from 12 weeks off.

runners.comment: C&D winner off 9lb lower last March; fair runs last twice and has an each-way chance
runners.name: Mayo County
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off a 9lb lower mark last March; also won a 7f handicap at Redcar in May; creditable efforts on last two starts (second over C&D on first occasion); has an each-way chance.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo who won over C&D on h'cap debut earlier this month; should improve; chance
runners.name: Rajstar
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 4yo who won over C&D on handicap debut earlier this month on first run over 6f (previous runs had been at 7f/1m); this looks a tougher race and is 5lb higher, but should improve.

runners.comment: Gained second of his 2 C&D wins in January and decent runs off this 5lb higher mark since
runners.name: Teardrops
runners.spotlight: Gained the second of his two C&D wins in January and has run creditably off this 5lb higher mark on last two starts; each-way player.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Saint-Vincent & E A R
runners.comment: 50-1 C&D winner off 11lb higher last February; back on a good mark; not in top form
runners.name: Mersea
runners.spotlight: 50-1 winner over C&D off 11lb higher in February last year; back on a good mark but hasn't been in top form recently.

runners.comment: Beat Spartan Fighter by a neck over C&D ten days ago and should go well if in same form
runners.name: Pit Boss
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to beat Spartan Fighter (3lb worse off, winner since) by a neck to get off the mark over C&D ten days ago and should go well if in the same form.

runners.comment: Made all to win third race over C&D last month; not disgraced when third here last time
runners.name: Yorkshire Glory
runners.spotlight: Made all to win his third race over C&D last month and not disgraced when third off this 2lb higher mark last time.

17:25.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses in Bands C and D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 0-12; good second in 5f Wolverhampton novice five days ago; she holds solid form claims
runners.name: Peregrine Falcon
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but proving a reliable sort and returned from a nine-week break with a good second of five in 5f Wolverhampton novice five days ago; she holds solid form claims.

runners.comment: Last of 8 in Newcastle novice last month; in good hands though and worth another chance
runners.name: Polka
runners.spotlight: Shaped encouragingly when third in a 6f novice here on her debut in September but came in last of eight in a similar event over that same C&D three months later; she's in good hands though and worth another chance.

runners.comment: Big step forward when second here latest, though dictated the pace; still a likely player
runners.name: Ruby Red Gove
runners.spotlight: Took a big step forward from her debut when second of six in 6f novice here three weeks ago, though she was allowed to dictate the pace; still rates a likely player.

runners.name: Merlier
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns foal, £30,000 breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to winners Horus (6f AW 2yo; RPR 71) and Beria (Spanish 6f-1m); dam, 5f 2yo winner (RPR 93), is out of a half-sister to Group 1 winners Sleepytime (1,000 Guineas) and Ali-Royal (Sussex Stakes); interesting newcomer for his in-form yard.
